question:
Which of the following options is the closest appro×imate value which will come in place of question mark (?) in the following equation?

26.52 × 3.89 - 7.79 × 2 + 27.39 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

Given : 26.52 × 3.89 - 7.79 × 2 + 27.39

Calculation :

26.52 × 3.89 - 7.79 × 2 + 27.39

Taking appro×imation: 27 × 4 - 8 × 2 + 27

= 108 - 16 + 27 = 119

Thus, the closest appro×imate value is 119.

**Hence, '119' is the correct answer.**
